```{r}
# Define the components and variables
input_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\comp_withincond_THz"
components <- c( "N350", "P2","N100")
variables <- c("comp_amp", "latency")


for (component in components) {
  data_table <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "\\", component, "_dataToR.csv"))  
  # Convert variables to factors:
  data_table$sov <- factor(data_table$sov, levels = c('wn', 'N2', 'N3', 'REM'), ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$sub <- factor(data_table$sub, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$hz <- factor(sub("T(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", data_table$cond))
  data_table$trial_pos <- as.integer(substr(data_table$cond, nchar(data_table$cond), nchar(data_table$cond)))
  data_table$is_peak <- factor(data_table$is_peak, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = FALSE) 
  data_table$comp_amp <- as.numeric(data_table$comp_amp) 
  data_table$latency <- as.numeric(data_table$latency) 
  
  for (varush in variables) {
    output_file_name <- paste0("res_lmm_", component, "_", varush, "_results.txt")
    # Redirect output to the file
    sink(output_file_name)
    
    #### Remove outliers:
    #std_to_remove_outliers <- 3
    #data_table <- data_table %>%
    #  group_by(sov) %>%
    #  mutate(mean_varush = mean(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE),
    #         sd_varush = sd(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    #  filter(abs(.data[[varush]] - mean_varush) <= std_to_remove_outliers * sd_varush) %>%
    #  ungroup()
    
    # filter
    #data_table <- data_table[data_table$is_peak == 1, ]

    
     generate_model_formula <- function(formula) {
        as.formula(paste(varush, formula))
      }

    
    # Fit the linear mixed-effects models
    models <- list(
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + hz  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz + trial_pos  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov * trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov * hz  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz * trial_pos  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + hz + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov * hz * trial_pos * (1 | sub)"), data = data_table)
    )
    
    
    # Print ANOVA results for models
    print("ANOVA results:")
    anova_results <- do.call(anova, models)
    #anova_results <- anova(models[[1]], models[[2]], models[[3]], models[[4]], models[[5]], models[[6]], models[[7]], models[[8]], models[[9]], models[[10]], models[[11]], models[[12]])
    print(anova_results[order(seq_len(nrow(anova_results))), ])
    
    # Print Bayes Factor results
    print("Bayes Factor results:")
    bayes_results <- bayesfactor_models(models)
    print(bayes_results)
    
    # Summarize res
    pvals <- anova_results$`Pr(>Chisq)`
    bf_values <- exp(bayes_results$log_BF)
    significant_models <- data.frame(
     Model = bayes_results$Model,
     P_value = pvals,
     BF = bf_values
    ) |> 
     subset(P_value < 0.05 & BF > 3)
    significant_models$Highest_BF <- significant_models$BF == max(significant_models$BF)
    significant_models$P_value <- format.pval(significant_models$P_value, digits = 3)
    significant_models$BF <- format(significant_models$BF, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    cat("\nSignificant Models (p < 0.05 and BF > 3):\n")
    cat("\nModel                                   P-value        BF        Best?\n")
    cat("------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
    for(i in 1:nrow(significant_models)) {
        cat(sprintf("%-40s %-12s %-10s %s\n",
            significant_models$Model[i],
            significant_models$P_value[i],
            significant_models$BF[i],
            ifelse(significant_models$Highest_BF[i], "*", " ")))
    }

    # 
    # # Loop through the models and fit using Tweedie and Gaussian distributions with glmmTMB
    # for (i in seq_along(models)) {
    #   cat("\nFitting Tweedie and Gaussian for", model_names[i], "\n")
    #   model_formula <- as.formula(paste(varush, "~ sov * cond + (1 | sub)"))

    #

    #   # Bayes Factor or AIC/BIC comparison
    #   bayes_out_tweedie <- tryCatch({
    #     bayesfactor_tweedie <- bayesfactor_models(model_tweedie, denominator = 1)
    #     cat(paste("Bayes Factor for Tweedie model (inverse):", 1 / as.numeric(bayesfactor_tweedie)))
    #     bayesfactor_tweedie
    #   }, error = function(e) {
    #     cat("Bayes Factor calculation failed for Tweedie model. Calculating AIC and BIC instead.")
    #     list(AIC = AIC(model_tweedie, model_gaussian), BIC = BIC(model_tweedie, model_gaussian))
    #   })
    #   
    #   # Extract and print AIC/BIC results

    #     cat(t(list(AIC_Tweedie = bayes_out_tweedie$AIC[1], AIC_Gaussian = bayes_out_tweedie$AIC[2])))
    #     cat(t(list(BIC_Tweedie = bayes_out_tweedie$BIC[1], BIC_Gaussian = bayes_out_tweedie$BIC[2])))
    #   }
    # 
    #   # Normality and residual plots
    #   qqnorm(residuals(models[[i]]))
    #   qqline(residuals(models[[i]]))
    #   plot(models[[i]], resid(., type = "pearson") ~ fitted(.), abline = 0)
    #   cat(shapiro.test(residuals(models[[i]])))
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Choose the variable to plot (amplitude or latency)
varush <- "comp_amp"  # Replace with "comp_amp" to plot amplitude instead

# Fit the final model with interaction
final_model <- lmer(as.formula(paste(varush, "~ sov * cond + (1 | sub)")), data = data_table)

# Get estimated marginal means for the interaction of sov and cond
emm <- emmeans(final_model, ~ sov * cond)

# Convert emmeans results to a data frame for plotting
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

# Plotting interaction plot for sov and cond with estimated marginal means
ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, fill = sov)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Interaction of Sleep Stage (sov) and Tone Repetition (cond) on", varush),
    x = "Tone Repetition (cond)",
    y = paste("Estimated Marginal Mean of", varush),
    fill = "Sleep Stage (sov)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save the plot as an image file if needed
ggsave(filename = paste("interaction_plot_", varush, ".png", sep = ""), width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# # Yoels Example:::::
# Compare the models using AIC
anova(row_glmmTMB, num_glmmTMB, row_num_glmmTMB,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB)


# Calculate Bayes factors for the models
library(bayestestR)
bayes_out_glmmTMB <- bayesfactor_models(row_glmmTMB, num_glmmTMB, row_num_glmmTMB,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB, denominator = 4)

# Print the inverse Bayes factor values for easier interpretation
print(1 / as.numeric(bayes_out_glmmTMB))

# Model Fitting Using glmmTMB with Gaussian Distribution------------

# Model 1: Random effect of SBJ_idx only
baseline_sbj_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ 1 + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                                    data = filtered_df, 
                                    family = gaussian)

# Model 2: Fixed effect of Row_Number (bin) and random effect of SBJ_idx
row_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ Row_Number + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                           data = filtered_df, 
                           family = gaussian)

# Model 3: Fixed effect of Row_Number (bin) and Number of items and random effect of SBJ_idx
row_num_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ Row_Number + num_presses + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                               data = filtered_df, 
                               family = gaussian)

# Model 4: Fixed effect of Number of items and random effect of SBJ_idx
num_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ num_presses + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                           data = filtered_df, 
                           family = gaussian)

# Extract the Gauusain power parameter - sanity check should be zero for gaussian
power_param <- family_params(num_glmmTMB_nor)
print(power_param)

# Compare the models using AIC
anova(row_glmmTMB_nor, num_glmmTMB_nor, row_num_glmmTMB_nor,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB_nor)
```
